script.line: Your phone battery always dying on you? It's the worst feeling, especially when you need it most.
First, let's tackle background app refresh. Go into your settings, find 'General', then 'Background App Refresh'. Turn it off completely, or at least for apps you don't need constantly updating.
Why does this help? Apps are constantly checking for updates even when you're not using them, silently draining your power. Turning it off stops them from doing that.
Next, manage your location services. Head to 'Privacy & Security', then 'Location Services'. Review each app and set non-essential ones to 'While Using the App' or 'Never'.
Many apps constantly track your location, even when they don't need to. This GPS activity is a huge battery hog. Limiting it saves significant power.
